decisions.reason: Organic sliced ham fits a scalable core cold-cuts category and likely remains worth keeping unless sales were clearly weak.
Organic sliced cured smoked pork is a plausible extension of the firm's established meat assortment, though its niche organic positioning makes it somewhat more vulnerable than standard lines.
Organic pepper-coated salami combines a familiar salami base with a modest flavor variation, which large German meat producers would usually retain if it achieved acceptable shelf turnover.
The beef in teriyaki aspic specialty looks like a narrow, service-counter novelty and is the kind of complex niche item management would likely discontinue after a short trial.
Fennel-flavoured sliced salami is a more niche taste profile in the German mass market, so a large producer would likely rationalize it if it did not become a strong repeat-purchase item.
Liver pâté with veal is a premium but relatively narrow subsegment, and management would be somewhat more likely to remove it than keep it if volumes stayed modest.
